title: Undeciphered: Proto-Elamite tablets of Iran
summary: One of the world's earliest scripts, used briefly in Iran before Elamite cuneiform, has still not been completely deciphered.
why: It is one of humanity's first experiments with writing, and we still cannot read it.
question: What do the Proto-Elamite tablets of early Iran actually say?
evidence: Tablets come mainly from Susa, with others from Tepe Sofalin, Tepe Yahya and Tepe Sialk; the script was in use only a few centuries.
wouldSettle: More tablets, especially longer or bilingual texts, allowing signs to be tied to sounds or words.
